instruction: A candid medium shot of a group of friends sitting on a grassy park lawn during the day, with trees and a red-and-white pennant banner hanging in the background. On the left, the woman with an afro (R6) in a red t-shirt and ripped blue jeans leans happily on a large black inflatable bowling ball. In the center-left background, the East Asian man (R3) in a red polo shirt sits holding up a white inflatable bowling pin. Next to him, the woman in a black beanie (R5) in a red t-shirt sits holding a pin in her lap, while behind her, the woman with tied-back hair (R4) in a dark blue t-shirt holds another pin. On the right, the bald man (R2) in a dark blue t-shirt sits holding a pin near his face. Bright, natural daylight casts soft shadows on the grass.
elements: R6 leans on a large black inflatable bowling ball rather than R3 leaning on it
R3 holds up a white inflatable bowling pin rather than R5 holding it up
R2 holds a bowling pin near his face rather than R4 holding it near R2's face
